title: Reword the seeded read-role description so it stops promising a broad hunt
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/templates.rs, replace team.claude.read's description 'multi-file gathers and codebase scans, read-only' with wording that names the narrow read job and points a broad multi-file scan at a role-less --kind gather. Change nothing else: no alias, no pinned agent, no model.
goal: A leader reading bee team show no longer names --role read for a broad hunt and receives bee-extract's narrow contract. Routing, aliases and pinned agents are untouched (gather-reads-the-read-slot D3, store dd4c22d3).
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml onboard and drivers tests green; bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind gather --role read still returns the bee-extract payload.
